name: shinchantw_cbt_d0_18_compare_v2_20260729_182152_045265
sql:
-- D0 18:00 (Asia/Shanghai) cohort comparison: TC 2026-07-29 vs SG 2026-05-08.
-- Event timestamps are assumed to be stored in Asia/Shanghai, matching existing daily-report SQL.
WITH
tc_blacklist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18
  WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
),
sg_blacklist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
  WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
),
sg_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
  WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
raw AS (
  SELECT 'TC 2026-07-29' AS cohort, v."#account_id" AS account_id, v."#user_id" AS user_id,
         v."#event_name" AS event_name, v."#event_time" AS event_time,
         v.role_lev AS role_level, CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
         CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS stage_code, v.sandbox, v.is_freebuy
  FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN tc_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 18:00:00'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'SG 2026-05-08', v."#account_id", v."#user_id", v."#event_name", v."#event_time",
         v.role_lev, CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER), CAST(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT), v.sandbox, v.is_freebuy
  FROM ta.v_event_13 v LEFT JOIN sg_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id
  INNER JOIN sg_users s ON v."#user_id"=s.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 18:00:00'
),
cohort_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cohort, account_id FROM raw WHERE event_name='new_role' AND account_id IS NOT NULL
),
events AS (
  SELECT r.* FROM raw r INNER JOIN cohort_users c ON r.cohort=c.cohort AND r.account_id=c.account_id
),
user_profile AS (
  SELECT c.cohort,c.account_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN e.event_name='new_role' THEN e.event_time END) AS first_role_time,
    MAX(e.event_time) AS last_event_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name='login' THEN e.event_time END) AS last_login_time,
    MAX(CAST(e.role_level AS BIGINT)) AS max_level,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name='charge' AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payer,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name='open_toysbox' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS toybox_opened,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name='stage_fight' AND e.stage_type=1001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS main_stage_player
  FROM cohort_users c LEFT JOIN events e ON c.cohort=e.cohort AND c.account_id=e.account_id
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
session_gaps AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,
    date_diff('second', CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP), LEAD(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort,account_id ORDER BY event_time)) AS next_gap_seconds
  FROM events WHERE event_name NOT LIKE '%app%'
),
duration AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN next_gap_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN next_gap_seconds ELSE 0 END)/60.0 AS active_minutes
  FROM session_gaps GROUP BY 1,2
),
main_stage AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,stage_code,
    CAST(role_level AS BIGINT) AS role_level
  FROM events WHERE event_name='stage_fight' AND stage_type=1001
    AND stage_code IS NOT NULL
),
stage_progress AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,MAX(stage_code) AS max_stage_code, MAX(role_level) AS max_stage_level
  FROM main_stage GROUP BY 1,2
),
first_stage_repeats AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,stage_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort,account_id,CAST(FLOOR(stage_code / 10) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY event_time) AS first_stage_attempt
  FROM main_stage WHERE MOD(stage_code, 10)=1
),
boss_fail AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,MIN(event_time) AS first_boss_fail_reentry_time
  FROM first_stage_repeats WHERE first_stage_attempt=2 GROUP BY 1,2
),
post_boss_activity AS (
  SELECT b.cohort,b.account_id,b.first_boss_fail_reentry_time,
    MIN(e.event_time) AS next_event_time
  FROM boss_fail b LEFT JOIN events e
    ON b.cohort=e.cohort AND b.account_id=e.account_id AND e.event_time>b.first_boss_fail_reentry_time
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
profile AS (
  SELECT p.*, COALESCE(d.active_minutes,0) AS active_minutes, sp.max_stage_code,sp.max_stage_level,
    CASE WHEN p.last_login_time IS NULL OR date_diff('minute', CAST(p.last_login_time AS TIMESTAMP), CASE WHEN p.cohort='TC 2026-07-29' THEN TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 18:00:00' ELSE TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 18:00:00' END)>=60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS idle_60m,
    CASE WHEN ba.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_boss_fail,
    CASE WHEN ba.account_id IS NOT NULL AND (ba.next_event_time IS NULL OR date_diff('minute', CAST(ba.first_boss_fail_reentry_time AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(ba.next_event_time AS TIMESTAMP))>30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_activity_30m_after_boss
  FROM user_profile p LEFT JOIN duration d ON p.cohort=d.cohort AND p.account_id=d.account_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_progress sp ON p.cohort=sp.cohort AND p.account_id=sp.account_id
  LEFT JOIN post_boss_activity ba ON p.cohort=ba.cohort AND p.account_id=ba.account_id
)
SELECT cohort, 'overview' AS section, 'all' AS segment,
  COUNT(*) AS users,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(payer)/COUNT(*),2) AS payer_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(active_minutes),2) AS avg_active_minutes,
  APPROX_PERCENTILE(active_minutes,0.5) AS p50_active_minutes,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(idle_60m)/COUNT(*),2) AS idle_60m_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(max_level),2) AS avg_max_level,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(main_stage_player)/COUNT(*),2) AS main_stage_penetration_pct,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(has_boss_fail)/COUNT(*),2) AS boss_fail_user_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2) AS toybox_empty_among_boss_fail_pct,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 AND no_activity_30m_after_boss=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2) AS empty_toybox_no_activity_30m_among_boss_fail_pct
FROM profile GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort,'duration_band',CASE WHEN active_minutes<5 THEN '<5m' WHEN active_minutes<15 THEN '5-15m' WHEN active_minutes<30 THEN '15-30m' WHEN active_minutes<60 THEN '30-60m' ELSE '60m+' END,
  COUNT(*),ROUND(100.0*SUM(payer)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(active_minutes),2),APPROX_PERCENTILE(active_minutes,0.5),ROUND(100.0*SUM(idle_60m)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(max_level),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(main_stage_player)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(has_boss_fail)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 AND no_activity_30m_after_boss=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2)
FROM profile GROUP BY 1,3
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort,'level_band',CASE WHEN max_level IS NULL THEN 'no level' WHEN max_level<10 THEN '<10' WHEN max_level<20 THEN '10-19' WHEN max_level<30 THEN '20-29' WHEN max_level<40 THEN '30-39' ELSE '40+' END,
  COUNT(*),ROUND(100.0*SUM(payer)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(active_minutes),2),APPROX_PERCENTILE(active_minutes,0.5),ROUND(100.0*SUM(idle_60m)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(max_level),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(main_stage_player)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(has_boss_fail)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 AND no_activity_30m_after_boss=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2)
FROM profile GROUP BY 1,3
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort,'boss_fail_toybox',CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=0 THEN 'no boss fail' WHEN toybox_opened=0 AND no_activity_30m_after_boss=1 THEN 'boss fail + empty + no activity 30m' WHEN toybox_opened=0 THEN 'boss fail + toybox empty' WHEN no_activity_30m_after_boss=1 THEN 'boss fail + nonempty + no activity 30m' ELSE 'boss fail + toybox nonempty' END,
  COUNT(*),ROUND(100.0*SUM(payer)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(active_minutes),2),APPROX_PERCENTILE(active_minutes,0.5),ROUND(100.0*SUM(idle_60m)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(AVG(max_level),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(main_stage_player)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(has_boss_fail)/COUNT(*),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2),ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_boss_fail=1 AND toybox_opened=0 AND no_activity_30m_after_boss=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_boss_fail),0),2)
FROM profile GROUP BY 1,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3;
